description: Record a run of a task's test case (by testCaseID or referenceID): passed, failed, blocked or skipped, with plain-text evidence and evidence files. Local filePaths are uploaded to the task attachments first. Every call adds a run and is never retried automatically, so do not repeat a call that succeeded.

evidence.description: Plain text: what was run and what was observed (commands, output, URLs).

fileIDs.description: fileID values already returned by laviya_upload_task_file for the same task.

filePaths.description: Local files to upload to the task first; images are shown inline, other files as links.

items.description: Local file path (absolute, or relative to the project root). Allowed: images (png, jpg, gif, webp), pdf, txt, md, log, json, csv, xml, zip, Office files, mp4, webm, mov; max 20 MiB.

referenceID.description: referenceID of the case instead of testCaseID.

testCaseID.description: Test case id from laviya_list_test_cases or laviya_create_test_cases.

name: laviya_report_test_result
title: Report Test Result
